Mode.Reinforcement.Name: Reinforcements
Mode.Reinforcement.Help.select: Select target hexes (Shift adds / Ctrl removes)
Mode.Reinforcement.Action.copy: Copy the selected hex's reinforcements and ownership
Mode.Reinforcement.Action.remove: Delete the reinforcements on the selected hexes
Mode.Reinforcement.Action.sync_belong: Set the ownership of reinforcement hexes
Mode.Reinforcement.Note.auto_owner: Placing, pasting and applying in the editor give reinforcements without a faction the faction that owns the province capital ([ / ] picks a fixed faction); the hex ownership follows the first reinforcement
Mode.Reinforcement.Note.layer: Reinforcement layer: 2 columns × 6 rows in the hex centre; green numbers are spawn turns, more than 12 show X<total>
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.UndoSyncBelong: Set the ownership of reinforcement hexes
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.Pasted: Pasted the reinforcement group ({0} per hex) to {1} hexes
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.NoneSelected: There are no reinforcements on the selected hexes
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.BelongSynced: Set the ownership of {0} reinforcement hexes
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.BelongAlreadySync: All reinforcement hexes already match their reinforcements' faction
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.OwnerAuto: Faction of new reinforcements: automatic (the faction that owns the province capital)
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.OwnerLegion: Faction of new reinforcements: faction {0} (action order {1}, {2})
Mode.Reinforcement.Msg.OwnerUnresolved: (faction unknown: neither the province capital nor this hex has an owner; press Q to set it in the editor)
Module.Reinforcement.Name: Reinforcement module
Module.Reinforcement.NoSuchRecord: That reinforcement is no longer on this hex (the list may have changed)
Module.Reinforcement.NoneAtHex: There are no reinforcements on this hex
Module.Reinforcement.Placed: Placed a reinforcement at ({0},{1}); {2} on this hex
Module.Reinforcement.Replaced: Replaced the reinforcement group at ({0},{1}) with {2}
Module.Reinforcement.ClipboardEmpty: Nothing to paste: copy a reinforcement group with C first
Module.Reinforcement.NoSuchLegion: Ownership {0} is not a faction on this map
Module.Reinforcement.FilledBelong: Added {1} reinforcements to the empty hexes owned by {0}
Module.Reinforcement.BadProbability: The probability must be between 0 and 100
Module.Reinforcement.Check.OutOfBelongRa: The hex is outside the ownership data range; the game ignores it
Module.Reinforcement.Check.UnitType: Unit type {0} is not in the unit table
Module.Reinforcement.Check.OwnerNotLegio: Faction {0} is not the action order of any faction on this map
Module.Reinforcement.Check.BelongMismatc: Hex ownership {0} differs from the reinforcement's faction (ownership {1}); press G to sync
Module.Reinforcement.Check.General: General {0} is not in the general table
Assist.Reinforce.Title: Reinforcement Editor
Assist.Reinforce.Tip.Belong: After applying, the hex ownership follows the first reinforcement's faction
Assist.Reinforce.Tip.Owner: Action order (ActionId) of the owning faction; 0 is filled in on apply from the faction that owns the province capital
Assist.Reinforce.Tip.Raw: Raw integer: the low bits hold the value, the high bits may pack other data; 0x hexadecimal is accepted
Assist.Reinforce.Tip.RandomGeneral: Pick a random general from the faction's country and fill in the rank and skill levels
Assist.Reinforce.Hint: Unit type, faction and general accept numbers; write hexadecimal as 0x…. Untouched fields keep their original values (some fields in game maps pack several values). Enter applies, Esc reverts.
Assist.Reinforce.BelongNotLegion: Ownership {0} (not a faction on this map)
Assist.Reinforce.OwnerAuto: Filled in on apply from the faction that owns the province capital
Assist.Reinforce.OwnerUnknown: ⚠ No faction on this map has action order {0}
Assist.Reinforce.GeneralPicked: Random general: {0} ({1}). Press Enter to apply
Assist.Reinforce.NoGenerals: The general table is empty; nothing to pick from
Assist.Reinforce.NoHex: Select a hex on the map first, then press Q to open the reinforcement editor
Assist.Reinforce.OutOfBelongRange: This hex is outside the ownership data range; the game ignores reinforcements here
Assist.Reinforce.RetargetBlocked: The current reinforcement has invalid input: fix it or press Esc to revert before switching hexes
